summary: PDF export feature fully verified end-to-end. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_pdf_export_pytest.py — POST /api/reports/daily/pdf returns {token, filename, share_path='/api/reports/shared/<token>', size_bytes>3000, photo_count, expires_at} for both admin and qc_executive; GET /api/reports/shared/<token> serves application/pdf (magic %PDF), Content-Disposition inline by default and attachment when ?download=1 is supplied; invalid token → 404; /api/reports/exports is properly scoped (qc sees own, admin sees all incl. qc's); photo_count == number of distinct photo_path values across the date's inspections (verified via /api/inspections?date= + /api/inspections/{id}); regression clean — /api/reports/daily still returns full JSON shape with a new 'scope' field ('ALL INSPECTIONS' for admin, contains 'OWN RECORDS' for qc), dashboard stats + inspections list unaffected. Frontend on mobile viewport 390x844: login (data-testid submit-auth-button) → /report; header shows document icon (testID export-pdf-icon) + share icon (testID share-report-button); date shown is 2026-08-26 (which had 1 Ghee Cake inspection with 1 photo); tapping the main EXPORT PDF button (testID export-pdf-button) toggles its label to '' (loading spinner shown by AppButton — original 'GENERATING PDF…' is hidden while loading=true) and then reveals the pdf-ready-card with filename, '…1 photo included · link valid 30 days', full shareable URL, and both testIDs open-pdf-button + share-pdf-link-button. Fetching that URL from the browser context returns 200 application/pdf 90,439 bytes starting with %PDF-1.4. Changing the date via testID date-prev correctly clears the pdf-ready-card. Minor UX nit: when exporting, the AppButton hides the 'GENERATING PDF…' label because AppButton hides children while loading=true; the toast 'PDF sign-off sheet ready' provides sufficient signal but the button appears blank for ~1 s which contradicts the requested visible 'GENERATING PDF…' text.

ui_bugs.issue: While exporting, the button label becomes blank instead of showing 'GENERATING PDF…'. AppButton renders only the ActivityIndicator when loading=true (children/title hidden). The title prop is already built as `exporting ? 'GENERATING PDF…' : 'EXPORT PDF SIGN-OFF SHEET'` but AppButton overrides it. Either (a) render the title next to the spinner while loading, or (b) drop `loading={exporting}` and keep the dynamic title so the user sees 'GENERATING PDF…'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/report.tsx:234-240 and /app/frontend/src/components/AppButton.tsx (loading branch).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning present on every screen load: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Cosmetic — comes from a library dependency, not app code.

action_items: LOW/OPTIONAL: In report.tsx, either drop `loading={exporting}` or update AppButton to keep showing the title next to the spinner, so users see 'GENERATING PDF…' rather than a blank button during ~1 s of PDF generation.
LOW: Suppress library-level 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning if noise-level becomes annoying (cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PDF flow correctly uses run_in_threadpool for both PDF build and object storage put/get (no blocking of the event loop).
Public share endpoint retries object storage read up to 4x with 1.5 s sleep to handle read-after-write delay — matches the observed behaviour of the storage layer.
share_path already includes the /api prefix; frontend correctly concatenates onto EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL without appending to a base that already ends in /api.
PDF builder (pdf_report.py) escapes user-controlled strings via _p() to avoid ReportLab paragraph XML injection.
MongoDB `_id` excluded on all export routes (verified in list_exports and inspections responses).
server.py has grown to ~1092 lines — still worth splitting into routers (auth/products/inspections/reports).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all target testIDs work, PDF opens as real PDF; only cosmetic blank-label during generation)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Two report_exports rows added to Mongo during testing (one admin, one qc for 2026-08-26); not cleaned up (matches iteration_2 policy).

In report.tsx (line 236) the title is already computed as 'GENERATING PDF…' but never rendered because loading={exporting} takes precedence. Two-line fix in either report.tsx (drop `loading` prop, keep dynamic title) or AppButton (render title alongside spinner).
